companyFieldUpdates.description: CleanCapital Holdings LLC develops, acquires, owns and operates distributed solar and energy-storage projects across the United States. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in New York, the platform serves commercial, industrial, institutional, utility and public-sector counterparties through contracted clean-energy assets. Current company materials report more than 350 projects and approximately 500 MW, with over US$1.5 billion invested. BlackRock Renewable Power Group funds made a direct investment in 2019, but that period is historical and the exact stake and exit date are not publicly disclosed. Manulife Investment Management made a corporate investment in 2021 and remains the only named current institutional backer; its exact percentage is not publicly disclosed. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP did not create a GIP ownership period. CleanCapital sold the 120 MW Nottingham development in April 2026 as an asset-level transaction and no platform sale or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
